findings: the tokenization gap narrows with training scale: 1.684 -> 1.212 BPB (-28.1%) from 600 to 2400 steps
ratec_direct improved 1.93x more BPB than bpe for the same 4x compute (-0.978 vs -0.505)
gap narrowed in every domain: en -25.1%, hr -23.6%, zh -35.5%, code -31.1% (zh narrows most)
direction confirmed, trend not established: two points, tiny model (1.27M params), gap still large (1.21 BPB) - bpe still wins decisively at this scale
consistent with the singleton-starvation hypothesis: 4x steps roughly quadruples samples per patch type
